source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.bark: Mostly smooth light-gray bark (genus character, not species-tested)
morphology_documented.leaves: Large evergreen coriaceous simple leaves to 12 × 6 cm; usually conspicuously spinose-dentate, sometimes almost entire
morphology_documented.flowers: Small axillary, frequently unisexual, often 4–5-merous (genus only)
morphology_documented.habitat: Flora indicates southeastern and eastern Texas just east of its north-central Texas coverage

source_scope_note: Genus-level traits are expressly indicated; absent species details not inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Species mentioned rather than presented in full regional treatment; no source-supported flowering period or height on this page
preservation: Additive record; original species.json, photos, credits and galleries unchanged
